question: Will Iran strike US military base at least once in August?
resolution_criteria:
Resolution criteria

This market resolves to YES if, at any point from August 1, 2026, through August 31, 2026, at 11:59 PM UTC, the armed forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran launch a direct military strike targeting a United States military base or installation. Otherwise, this market resolves to NO.

Definitions & Details:

Direct strike: This includes the launch of ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, rockets, or one-way attack drones/UAVs that target, impact, or are intercepted in the immediate vicinity of a U.S. military facility.

Iran: "Iran" refers to the state's official military forces, including the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) or the regular Iranian armed forces (Artesh). Strikes executed solely by regional proxy militias (e.g., the Houthis in Yemen, or Popular Mobilization Forces in Iraq) do not qualify, unless official U.S. or international defense reports state that the strike was directly launched by Iranian state forces, or the Iranian government/military officially claims direct responsibility for the attack.

U.S. military base or installation: Any official military base, outpost, airbase, or facility hosting U.S. armed forces (such as bases in Jordan, Iraq, Syria, or elsewhere in the region). Strikes targeting U.S. Navy vessels, carrier strike groups, or commercial shipping do not count.

Source of truth: Official statements, press releases, or briefings from the U.S. Department of Defense (defense.gov), U.S. Central Command (centcom.mil), or consensus reporting from major reputable international news organizations (e.g., Reuters, Associated Press, Bloomberg).

Background

Following the outbreak of direct conflict between the United States and Iran in early 2026, regional hostilities have escalated significantly. In late July 2026, Iran launched multiple ballistic missiles targeting a U.S. military base hosting troops in Jordan. This prompted a heavy wave of retaliatory airstrikes by U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) against IRGC command centers, missile sites, and drone facilities inside Iran. Traders will assess whether this pattern of direct exchanges results in another Iranian strike on a U.S. base during the month of August.

# Research report 1 of 2

I found no credible report of an Iranian state strike on a US base between August 1 and August 25, 2026. The last such strikes I found were on July 28-29 and July 31. A US-Iran ceasefire was reportedly extended in mid-August, and neither side struck the other's territory from about July 30 through at least August 23. Several search results described events after August 25, so I left them out.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question names official statements from defense.gov or centcom.mil, or consensus reporting from Reuters, AP or Bloomberg. It gives no specific URL.
- I could not open centcom.mil, CNN or GlobalSecurity because the proxy refused the connection. The status below comes from search-result summaries of those pages.
- 2026-08-23: GlobalSecurity's Day 177 log says CENTCOM had confirmed no US or Israeli strike inside Iran, the 24th night in a row without one. It also says no Iranian ballistic missile launch was reported in that window. [GlobalSecurity Day 177](https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/ops/iran-war-20260823.htm)
- 2026-08-20: The Day 174 log likewise shows no strikes on Iranian territory and no CENTCOM release. [GlobalSecurity Day 174](https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/ops/iran-war-20260820.htm)

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-08-25, nothing has happened that settles the question. Six days of August remain (Aug 26-31), and the question resolves YES if a qualifying strike happens in that time.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-21: The US announced "Economic D-Day" sanctions aimed at Iran's trade partners. Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary, Mohsen Rezaei, said any country supporting this "economic war" would be treated as committing an act of war, and threatened to halt oil exports through Hormuz. I found no explicit new threat against US bases. [Asharq Al-Awsat](https://english.aawsat.com/node/5310383), [Macau Business](https://macaubusiness.com/iran-defiant-as-us-threatens-economic-d-day/), [FDD](https://fdd.org/in_the_news/quotes/2026/08/21/trump-warns-of-economic-d-day-against-iran-but-tehran-is-well-acquainted-with-sanctions)
- 2026-08-21: The US Treasury sanctioned a cash-courier network linked to the IRGC, Iran's Revolutionary Guard. [GlobalSecurity Day 175](https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/ops/iran-war-20260821.htm)
- 2026-08-18: The UAE detected two ballistic missiles fired from Iran. Both fell into the sea, and one report says they were aimed at shipping. That would not count under the criteria. This was the UAE's first missile alert since July 12. [Khaleej Times](https://www.khaleejtimes.com/uae/missile-threat-emergency-alert-warning-august-18-2026), [Aletihad](https://en.aletihad.ae/amp/news/uae/4685981/uae-detects-two-ballistic-missiles-fired-from-iran--one-fall)
- 2026-08-18: Trump said no talks with Iran were underway. [CNN headline](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/18/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)
- 2026-08-17: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson said the 60-day negotiating window was no longer relevant. [AzerNews](https://www.azernews.az/region/262502.html)
- 2026-08-12: Reuters-sourced and Anadolu reports said the US and Iran agreed in principle to extend the Pakistan-brokered ceasefire before its August 17 deadline. Iranian officials reportedly denied this. [ProPakistani](https://propakistani.pk/2026/08/12/us-iran-extend-islamabad-ceasefire/), [Aaj](https://english.aaj.tv/news/330467531)
- Early August (exact date unconfirmed): Trump reportedly paused strikes to give talks another chance, while the naval blockade of Iranian ports continued. [Keene Sentinel](https://www.keenesentinel.com/eedition/page-a6/page_87961d8b-29f5-56af-ac3f-ff5fb2268119.html)
- 2026-07-31: Iran's regular army (Artesh) said its drones hit US facilities at Ahmad al-Jaber air base in Kuwait. This was not verified. [Intellinews](https://www.intellinews.com/iran-s-army-claims-drone-strike-on-us-facilities-at-kuwait-s-ahmad-al-jaber-base-458243/), [GlobalSecurity Day 154](https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/ops/iran-war-20260731.htm)
- 2026-07-28/29: The IRGC fired ballistic missiles at a US base in Jordan. CENTCOM said all were intercepted. [Pajhwok](https://pajhwok.com/2026/07/29/iran-says-it-targeted-us-base-in-jordan-with-ballistic-missiles/)

## 4. Base rates
- The war began around February 28, 2026, so July 31 was Day 154. Iran claimed or carried out strikes on US-hosting bases in Jordan on June 11, about July 12-14 and July 28-29, and in Kuwait on July 31. [Jakarta Post](https://thejakartapost.com/world/2026/07/14/iran-says-it-struck-us-air-base-in-jordan), [Wikipedia: strikes on Jordan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Iranian_strikes_on_Jordan)
- Iranian strikes on US bases have tended to come in retaliation for US strikes on Iran. From April to early July, a ceasefire held and the June 17 memorandum (MoU) was in place, and attacks appear to have been rare. Fighting resumed between July 8 and July 24. [Aaj](https://english.aaj.tv/news/330467531)
- The current lull is at least 24 days long. If it holds, August would have no qualifying strike.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Manifold has a market with the same wording: ["Will Iran strike US military base at least once in August?"](https://manifold.markets/apol/will-iran-strike-us-military-base-a). One snapshot showed about 69% YES, but I could not tell its date. It may date from early August, before the lull lengthened. Related market: [Terminator2's version](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/will-iran-directly-strike-a-us-mili).
- I found no matching Polymarket or Kalshi market.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The status of the ceasefire extension is unclear, and the US and Iran give conflicting accounts. A breakdown would raise the chance of strikes.
- The sanctions campaign is escalating and the naval blockade continues. Both could provoke Iran.
- Friction in the Strait of Hormuz is ongoing, including the August 18 missile launches. In the July pattern, a US strike on Iranian territory was quickly followed by IRGC strikes on bases in Jordan or Kuwait.
- I found no scheduled talks or deadlines for August 26-31.

[Local10/AP](https://www.local10.com/news/world/2026/08/02/trump-frequently-announces-hes-halting-strikes-in-iran-but-they-keep-happening/)

[Tasnim](https://www.tasnimnews.ir/en/news/2026/07/31/3660569/iran-s-army-hits-us-military-facilities-in-kuwait/amp), [Times of Oman](https://timesofoman.com/article/175078-iranian-army-says-it-struck-us-air-base-in-kuwait)
- 2026-07-28/30: The IRGC fired ballistic missiles at a US base in Jordan. CENTCOM said all were intercepted and then launched a "heavy wave" of strikes inside Iran. Iran's army then said it carried out drone strikes on US bases in Bahrain and Jordan. [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/07/28/iran-missile-attack-us-base-jordan), [IranWire](https://iranwire.com/en/news/155604-iran-fires-ballistic-missiles-at-us-base-in-jordan-centcom-says-all-intercepted/), [The Hill](https://thehill.com/policy/defense/5995522-iran-missile-attack-us-base/)

## 4. Base rates
- March to July 2026: Iranian strikes on US bases were frequent during active phases of the war. These included strikes on Jordan on July 17 (US personnel killed), Jordan, Bahrain and Kuwait on July 20-24, Jordan on July 28-30, and Kuwait on July 31. [Pajhwok](https://pajhwok.com/2026/07/24/iran-says-it-launched-drone-strikes-on-us-bases-in-bahrain-jordan-kuwait/), [Wikipedia: strikes on Jordan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Iranian_strikes_on_Jordan)
- Calm periods have also occurred: the April-May ceasefire and the June memorandum-of-understanding period, with the UAE reporting no missile alerts from July 12 to August 18.
- The pattern is that Iranian strikes on bases have generally followed US strikes on Iran. I found no report of US strikes inside Iran between August 1 and August 24.
- Many Iranian claims are never confirmed by CENTCOM. That matters for resolution, although an official Iranian claim of responsibility counts under the rules.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Manifold has markets on this exact question. [Manifold: apol](https://manifold.markets/apol/will-iran-strike-us-military-base-a), [Manifold: Terminator2](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/will-iran-directly-strike-a-us-mili). I could not find their price as of August 25.
- I found no matching Polymarket or Kalshi market.

## 6. Upcoming events before August 31
- Oman's foreign minister visits Tehran on August 25, following the Pakistani army chief's visit on August 24.
- New US sanctions were to be announced on Monday, August 24, according to the August 22 reporting. Iran has threatened a response through Hormuz.
- The ceasefire has formally lapsed and the US blockade continues. Any US strike on Iranian territory would historically be the most likely trigger for Iranian retaliation against a base.
- Trump's August 1 strike pause depends on the talks continuing.
